# EASTERN MIND — WIRING INVENTORY

Complete file inventory of `teardown/eastern-mind/` on `main`, generated from the git tree
(GitHub git-trees API, recursive, `truncated: false`). This file is the wiring checklist for the
Eastern Mind lane of the Full Wiring + Canon Conversion order (owner, 2026-10-20 ~08:06 CDT).

- **Total files (blobs): 5,707** — count method: git tree entries under `teardown/eastern-mind/` with `type == "blob"` (5,931 total tree entries including 224 directories).
- **Total size: 420,423,503 bytes** (sum of git blob sizes).
- **Composition:** 5,321 PNG bitmaps, 233 WAV audio, 49 `.pal`, 48 `.bin` palettes, 31 text files, 24 MP4 videos, 1 Markdown document (counts by extension).
- **Wiring key:** WIRED = folded into WH canon and/or consumed by WH game data at the category/system level, with the consuming path cited. WIRED-PENDING-MERGE = wired by the PR that adds this inventory. NOT WIRED = no canon/game consumer; every NOT WIRED group is flagged with a reason in `teardown/eastern-mind/CANON-CONVERSION.md`.
- **Asset-level honesty note:** no file under `teardown/eastern-mind/` is loaded individually by game code today (no reference to this directory exists in `game/js/assets.js`, `game/js/audio.js`, `game/js/main.js`, `game/js/stages.js` or `game/js/modes.js`). Stage identity, systems and canon are wired; direct per-file engine consumption (stage textures, face bitmaps, world audio) is the flagged follow-up recorded in CANON-CONVERSION.md.
